notes.notes:

notes.title: The necessary Redevelopment is making progress
notes.notes:
I hope this message finds you well. I'm writing to provide an important update on the game's development. Regrettably, due to complications with previous backups, I've had to rebuild Echoes of Fear from scratch. Progress stands at about 25%, and I'm working diligently to balance these efforts alongside existing family commitments.

Your unwavering support means everything to me. While I'm targeting a release by the first quarter, I want to convey that there's potential for the game to be ready even sooner. However, please understand that these commitments might affect the timeline.

Rest assured, I'm committed to keeping you informed regularly regarding our progress and any potential adjustments to the release schedule.

Thank you for your continued dedication to the Echoes of Fear community.

notes.title: Just a little technical hurdle..
notes.notes:
I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to take a moment to reach out to you regarding a recent setback that has affected the development of my game. It's one of those moments every developer hopes to avoid but occasionally faces: a technical hiccup that has caused quite a disruption.

Unfortunately, I encountered an unexpected issue with my system where Windows experienced a critical failure, necessitating a complete reinstallation. While I had backups in place, the challenge arose when I discovered that Unreal Engine 5.0 was no longer available for download after the reinstall.

Adapting to the situation, I promptly transitioned the game version to UE5.3, hoping for a seamless continuation. However, despite my efforts, I encountered obstacles in opening the game. Rest assured, I'm diligently exploring various workarounds to ensure that the game is fully operational before delivering it to you.

I truly appreciate your patience and support during this time. Your enthusiasm and encouragement mean the world to me, especially as an indie developer navigating the intricacies of game development. It's humbling to have such an incredible community standing by my side.

Should my attempts to rectify the issue fall short, regrettably, I may need to rebuild the game from scratch. This could potentially result in alterations to the map layout and foliage, impacting the current gameplay experience. Updates may be temporarily suspended until I can restore the game to its original state or reimagine a completely new map design.

Once again, I extend my heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you who have invested in this project. Your unwavering support motivates me to overcome these challenges and deliver an exceptional gaming experience. Rest assured, I'm working tirelessly to resolve this setback and bring you the game you deserve.

Rest assured, should anyone feel that this inconvenience affects their experience, refunds will be available hassle-free. Your satisfaction remains our top priority.

Thank you for your understanding and ongoing support.

Warm Regards,
GamersFortitude

notes.title: Ease of Navigation Update
notes.notes:
Found yourself wandering throughout the map and have no idea where you are? Worry no more, you will now have a easier time! 

The update will include these features as well as some minor bug fixes.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collision on rocks fixed near one of the first houses you come across.
[*] Deer now run away
[/list]

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minimap and compass added for ease of Navigation
[*] Controls can be viewed on the fly by pressing F1
[/list]
